parsed.post: Discarded the experiment (1.0584) as it regressed from my best (1.0182). My attempt to lower the LR to 0.10 on the high-capacity model (D6, AR64) caused instability. Reverting to e4b75ff. Next: I'll try a very small increase in LR from 0.06 to 0.08 to see if 0.10 was just too high.
